entities.summary: Viktor Palokaj, known professionally as Unikkatil, is a Kosovan rapper, singer, songwriter and record producer. He was one of the first Albanian language rappers and the leader of TBA. He has never had a single music video filmed. Although nowadays he is not as active in the music industry as he used to be he is still considered by many as the best Albanian rapper of all time.
